tools.name: list_capabilities
tools.description: List Spocal MCP capabilities: the sports data tools, and the article authoring workflow for publishing to Spocal. Call this first to learn how to embed matches, players and prediction markets in an article.

tools.name: list_supported_competitions
tools.description:
List a capped set of supported competitions without schedule rows.

The `url` field on each result is that entity's canonical Spocal URL. To cite it in article Markdown, write the URL on a line of its own; the publisher expands a standalone Spocal URL into a match card. Use the returned value verbat
